notes.title: 9th Feb Update #2
notes.notes:
- Fixed FPS issues where some users FPS was not respecting the games FPS limits.
- Changed main menu theme music.
- Changed game over sound so its not deafening.
- Normalised volumes across entire game so the slider gives expected results.
- Removed rain completely from game for now.
- Changed how the game over scene works to stop the delay between dying/game over loading.

notes.title: Update for 9th Feb.
notes.notes:
Added Discord Rich Presence.
 Optimised the car selection script.
 Fixed pause bug, you can't pause now if your score is 0 at the start.
 Added ability to play along to your own music. Click the music button in the top right to find out how.

notes.title: 6th Feb Update!
notes.notes:
Added new music!
 Upgraded engine from unity 2020 to unity 6 to allow for future optimisations and features!
 Locked fps to users refresh rate and enabled vsync.
 Added pause ability (Esc) and countdown on unpausing.
 Added simple anticheat to stop people pausing and editing their score.
 Added skip track button (N).
 Updated games graphics settings some more to reduce anti aliasing settings and HDR effects where it wasn't really providing any benefit.
 Fixed some texture issues, e.g. the octane. It had a random white line above the car.


As always, visit the discord if you have any support problems or want to support us developing this game :D https://discord.gg/SvzgGrsN5G

notes.title: 4th February 2025 Update!
notes.notes:
Rain is now random
 Added FPS counter
 Set graphics quality to low to support lower end pc's - no real difference to player
 Set pipes to delete faster when off screen to reduce resource usage
 Added final score, final speed, and total time to game over screen
 UI changes to main game score/speed display


Once again, join the discord if you have any problems :)

https://discord.gg/SvzgGrsN5G

notes.title: Update 4th February - EXPERT MODE!
notes.notes:
Reduced car size by 5%
Added Expert mode and new leaderboard. You have to boost here, not jump :)

Come visit our Discord to chat with other top players :D https://discord.gg/SvzgGrsN5G

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed the volume control so it now respects your choices.
Fixed the fade in/out and dim screen bug.

notes.title: F2P Update 1.1
notes.notes:
As I have made the game free 2 play, I have optimised the menu and performance so it is more playable.

I may continue to update this in the future if I find some time :D

notes.title: RELEASE DAY! & 0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
- Performance enhancements.
- Adjusted controls diagram.
- More leaderboard UI changes.
- Removed the red city background as it does not match the rest of the games colour palette.
- Lowered volume for new players so that it isn't a jump scare anymore.

Also, GAME RELEASED!!!
